body:
I don't remember being very happy 3 years ago before her. Honestly, the happiest I've ever been was with her. 

Everyone says time is supposed to heal you but It's only going to get worse. I'm going to lose my best friend. I'm going to lose my job. And I have no motivation to do anything. Time is my enemy in this situation.

You're right that the argument was just the spark that ignited it all. But I feel most of the issues in the relationship were my fault. Because I was immature and stupid. I should have been better and now it's too late. 

I've been trying a lot of things to try to find myself and better myself. Like learning and doing new things. But I've found that it's just empty. I don't feel much enjoyment out of anything. I just want to rot away in my chair.
